findings.title: ADR-001 through ADR-005 each missing Date, Author, Decider in per-ADR frontmatter sections
findings.detail: Each of the 5 ADRs in docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md had a **Status: DRAFT** header but was missing **Date:**, **Author:**, and **Decider:** fields. The file-level frontmatter block had all five fields, but the per-ADR headers (which are the actionable decision records) lacked them. Added Date: 2026-05-20, Author: T1 (overnight elevation-push, split 20260520-2244), and Decider: Sebastian Puig (pending review) to ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-003, ADR-004, and ADR-005.
findings.fix_sketch: Added Date/Author/Decider to all five per-ADR header sections in docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md.

findings.title: ADR-Proposer-001 embedded in proposer-spec.md has no frontmatter at all

findings.fix_sketch: Add Date: 2026-05-20, Author: T5 (overnight elevation-push, split 20260520-2244), Decider: Sebastian Puig (pending review) after the **Status:** DRAFT line in the ADR-Proposer-001 section.

findings.title: Finding ID in 20260703T050000Z.json uses descriptive text not 8 hex chars
findings.detail: .audits/20260703T050000Z.json contains at least one finding whose ID uses a descriptive slug (e.g. 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-phase4-gate-overdue') rather than the required 8-character hex suffix format (e.g. 'AUDIT-audit-elevation-c3a7f912') specified in rubric.json. This breaks fingerprint deduplication since the regression-detector joins on ID format.
findings.fix_sketch: Read the file, identify the non-conforming IDs, compute proper 8-hex-char suffixes from the finding fingerprints, and rewrite the IDs. Update any cross-references in index.json.

findings.title: ADR-004 suggests 30-min reap TTL but lane-scheduler-spec.md implements 60-min prune
findings.detail: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md ADR-004 Open Questions section says 'Suggest: each entry has a heartbeat_ts field; scheduler reaps entries older than 30 minutes.' docs/lane-scheduler-spec.md specifies a 60-minute prune interval for stale entries. These two specs describe the same TTL mechanism with conflicting values. Requires Sebastian decision on which is canonical.
findings.fix_sketch: Either update ADR-004 to match lane-scheduler-spec.md (60 min) or update lane-scheduler-spec.md to match ADR-004 (30 min). Document the decision. Requires Sebastian input — this is a design parameter, not a typo.

findings.title: Phase 2 prerequisites table still marked BLOCKING from May 2026 — 7 weeks stale

As of 2026-07-11 (51 days later), there is no indication this has been resolved or that the status has been updated. findings.fix_sketch: Check if Codex CLI is now installed. If yes, update the prerequisites table. If no, update the table to note current date and confirm still blocked. Either way, the stale May-2026 date needs a status note.

findings.title: Self-healing deferrals reference '2-week soak' which completed ~2026-06-04 — decisions still pending
findings.detail: plan.md and self-heal-pipeline.md both contain language deferring decisions to 'after the 2-week Phase 3 soak'. The soak completed approximately 2026-06-04 (37 days ago as of 2026-07-11). The deferred decisions have not been made: Phase 4 gate evaluation is 37 days overdue. The language 'after the soak' is now temporally incorrect — the soak is done; the decisions are simply pending.
findings.fix_sketch: Update deferred-to-soak language in plan.md to read 'soak completed 2026-06-04; decision pending Sebastian review' rather than implying the soak is still in progress.

findings.title: ADR-001 through ADR-005 use 3-digit numbering; IFleet ADR convention uses 4-digit
findings.detail: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md uses 3-digit ADR IDs (ADR-001, ADR-002 … ADR-005). IFleet's docs/adr/ directory uses 4-digit IDs (ADR-0001, ADR-0002, ADR-0003, ADR-0004). Since these integration ADRs will eventually fold into IFleet, the numbering convention mismatch will cause confusion at merge time. This is cosmetic — the content is unambiguous — but worth aligning before the fold-in.
findings.fix_sketch: Decide on a canonical format. If IFleet's 4-digit format wins, rename the section headers from ADR-00N to ADR-000N within the integration-adrs file. Low priority; do before fold-in PR.
